scope: Actual binaries are inspected as data, never executed by this collector. Each host has 44 focused tests, six failure configurations, four deliberately broken builder cleanup controls, four compact-set configurations, an extra-slot control, eight range-set allocation configurations and nine paired cost cases. Range-set tests also reject missing size guards, missing releases and ordinary construction under a one-allocation budget. Timing compares fused and ordinary fwp, not C/Rust. Native section sizes are recorded; assembly must be reviewed before any claim about register placement or vectorization. Passing focused evidence does not replace production acceptance.

compactSets.scope: Observed requests to the managed allocator for a freshly built I64 set. Charged bytes include allocator rounding, not process RAM or child storage. Empty sets use static storage. The previous 8 + 16*n layout is calculated from its representation, not timed here. ARC charge returns to its starting value after each result is freed; tracing does not assert that ledger. These instrumented executions are not a speed benchmark.

rangeSets.scope: Observed managed allocation requests while an exported function builds an I64 range set. Includes input list and scratch construction; excludes startup, output, allocator headers and rounding. Both implementations produce and check every key. ARC charge returns to baseline after release. No timing claim follows from these instrumented executions.
